title: Bluegill Triple Prime as a proto-SDI X-ray missile defense

tellings.quote: strategic defense initiative. Yeah. And and if you look at Bluegill Triple Prime

plain: Bluegill Triple Prime, an American project of 1962 and 1963, was an early version of the Strategic Defense Initiative, the later US plan to shoot down missiles, here using X-rays as a missile defense. Michels makes this link himself, drawing on a paper by the RAND Corporation, a research group that works for the US government, and on a man named Harold Malmgren, whom he had interviewed. If true, the idea of that kind of defense would be decades older than the public plan.
